device.lifecycle.kicker.phone.comment: Small caption above the connection symbol while the phone is not linked.

device.lifecycle.kicker.ready.comment: Small caption above the symbol when the phone is linked and no route is active.

device.lifecycle.kicker.route.comment: Small caption above the symbol while the phone computes a route.

device.lifecycle.subtitle.ready.en-US: Choose a destination on the phone

device.lifecycle.title.connect_phone.comment: Large title: the device waits for the phone app.

device.lifecycle.title.connected.comment: Large title shown briefly after the handshake completes.

device.lifecycle.title.connecting.comment: Large title: Bluetooth link and handshake in progress.

device.lifecycle.title.planning.comment: Large title: the phone is computing the route.

device.lifecycle.title.ready.comment: Large title: linked, waiting for the rider to pick a destination.

device.music.like.comment: Small music button that likes the current track.

device.music.liked.comment: The same button after the like was sent.

device.music.phone_media.comment: Music page source line when the phone does not name the player.

device.music.phone_not_connected.comment: Music page source line when the phone media link is down.

device.music.waiting.comment: Music page title while no phone is connected.

device.power_off.comment: Last frame before the device removes power.

device.status.acquiring_gps.comment: Top status line: waiting for a usable GPS fix.

device.status.arrived.comment: Top status line at the destination.

device.status.demo.comment: Top status line while the built-in demo ride drives the display.

device.status.no_hotspot.comment: Top status line: the phone has no mobile data while navigating.

device.status.rerouting.comment: Top status line: the route is being recalculated.

device.status.route_cached.comment: Top status line: guidance continues on the stored route without network.

device.unit.km.comment: Unit after the distance to the next turn, from 1 km.

device.unit.kmh.comment: Speed unit on the speedometer and compass pages.

device.unit.m.comment: Unit after the distance to the next turn, under 1 km.

web.backend.needs_key.comment: Feedback: server up but no AMap key.
web.backend.needs_key.en-US: The server is running but has no AMap web service key yet.
web.backend.needs_key.pt-BR: O servidor está no ar, mas ainda não tem a chave do serviço web do AMap.
web.backend.needs_key.zh-Hans: 服务器已启动，但还没有配置高德 Web 服务 Key。

web.backend.offline.comment: Feedback: the route service is not online.
web.backend.offline.en-US: The live route service is not online yet; navigation cannot start.
web.backend.offline.pt-BR: O serviço de rotas ao vivo ainda não está no ar; não dá para iniciar a navegação.
web.backend.offline.zh-Hans: 真实路线服务尚未上线，当前无法开始导航。

web.demo.route_name.comment: Name of the built-in Jinan demo route.
web.demo.route_name.en-US: Shandong Big Data Industrial Base, Building D → Inspur Group HQ
web.demo.route_name.pt-BR: Base Industrial de Big Data de Shandong, Prédio D → Sede do Grupo Inspur
web.demo.route_name.zh-Hans: 山东省大数据产业基地D栋 → 浪潮集团(总部)

web.demo.short_name.comment: Short name of the demo route on the ride bar.

web.description.comment: Page description for search engines and link previews.
web.description.en-US: MOTO GPS live phone navigation: AMap routes, rerouting, traffic refresh and the shared LVGL round-display interface.
web.description.pt-BR: Navegação ao vivo no celular do MOTO GPS: rotas do AMap, recálculo, trânsito atualizado e a mesma interface LVGL da tela redonda.
web.description.zh-Hans: MOTO GPS 手机前台实时导航：高德路线、偏航重算、路况刷新和共享 LVGL 圆屏界面。

web.duration.minutes.comment: Fallback duration when Intl.DurationFormat is missing; {minutes} is a number.

web.error.request_failed.comment: Request failed; {status} is the HTTP status.

web.error.unreadable.comment: Service returned unreadable data; {status} is the HTTP status.
web.error.unreadable.zh-Hans: 服务返回了无法读取的数据（HTTP {status}）

web.home.back.comment: Accessible name of the brand button that returns to search.

web.location.accuracy_live.comment: Accuracy line with a good fix; {meters} is a number.
web.location.accuracy_live.pt-BR: Precisão de cerca de ±{meters} m, atualizando ao vivo
web.location.accuracy_live.zh-Hans: 当前精度约 ±{meters} 米，持续实时更新

web.location.accuracy_wait.comment: Accuracy line with a poor fix; {meters} is a number.
web.location.accuracy_wait.en-US: Accuracy about ±{meters} m; wait in an open area
web.location.accuracy_wait.pt-BR: Precisão de cerca de ±{meters} m; espere num lugar aberto
web.location.accuracy_wait.zh-Hans: 当前精度约 ±{meters} 米，请到开阔处等待

web.location.again.comment: Button to request a new fix.

web.location.allow_precise.comment: Hint while the system prompt is open.
web.location.allow_precise.en-US: Allow precise location in the system prompt.
web.location.allow_precise.pt-BR: Permita a localização precisa no aviso do sistema.
web.location.allow_precise.zh-Hans: 请在系统提示中允许精确位置。

web.location.copy.comment: Location card explanation before a fix.
web.location.copy.en-US: Route, rerouting and heading are computed from the phone's live location.
web.location.copy.pt-BR: A rota, o recálculo e a direção vêm da localização ao vivo do celular.
web.location.copy.zh-Hans: 路线、偏航和车头方向都从手机实时定位计算。

web.location.denied.en-US: Location permission denied. Allow location for this site in Safari settings.
web.location.denied.pt-BR: Permissão de localização negada. Permita a localização deste site nos ajustes do Safari.
web.location.denied.zh-Hans: 定位权限被拒绝，请在 Safari 网站设置中允许位置访问。

web.location.failed.en-US: Location failed; check the system location permission.
web.location.failed.pt-BR: A localização falhou; confira a permissão de localização do sistema.
web.location.failed.zh-Hans: 定位失败，请检查系统定位权限。

web.location.failed_title.comment: Location card title after an error.

web.location.locked.comment: Location card title with a good fix.

web.location.low_accuracy.comment: Location card title with a poor fix.

web.location.needs_https.comment: Location needs HTTPS and a capable browser.
web.location.needs_https.en-US: Phone location needs an HTTPS page and a browser with location support.
web.location.needs_https.pt-BR: A localização do celular precisa de página HTTPS e de um navegador com localização.
web.location.needs_https.zh-Hans: 手机定位要求 HTTPS 页面和支持定位的浏览器。

web.location.ready.en-US: Location ready; now enter a destination.
web.location.ready.pt-BR: Localização pronta; agora digite um destino.
web.location.ready.zh-Hans: 位置已就绪，现在输入目的地。

web.location.test_ready.comment: Feedback with the local test position.
web.location.test_ready.en-US: Local test position ready; now enter a destination.
web.location.test_ready.pt-BR: Posição de teste local pronta; agora digite um destino.
web.location.test_ready.zh-Hans: 本地测试位置已就绪，现在输入目的地。

web.location.timeout.en-US: Location timed out; try again shortly.
web.location.timeout.pt-BR: A localização demorou demais; tente de novo em instantes.

web.location.title.comment: Location card title before a fix.

web.location.unavailable.en-US: Location unavailable right now. Go outdoors or check the system location service.
web.location.unavailable.pt-BR: Localização indisponível agora. Vá para um lugar aberto ou confira o serviço de localização.
web.location.unavailable.zh-Hans: 暂时无法取得位置，请到室外或检查系统定位服务。

web.preview.lifecycle.comment: Destination name of the connection-lifecycle preview.
web.preview.lifecycle.pt-BR: Prévia da conexão da tela redonda

web.preview.lifecycle_status.comment: Route status in the connection-lifecycle preview.
web.preview.lifecycle_status.pt-BR: Tela de verificação do ciclo de conexão do firmware.
web.preview.lifecycle_status.zh-Hans: 当前为固件连接生命周期验收画面。

web.ride.arrived.comment: Ride alert and speech at the destination.

web.ride.confirm_end.en-US: End the current navigation and go back to search?
web.ride.confirm_end.pt-BR: Encerrar a navegação atual e voltar à busca?
web.ride.confirm_end.zh-Hans: 结束当前导航并返回搜索？

web.ride.end.comment: End button on the ride bar.

web.ride.offline.comment: Ride alert when the network drops.
web.ride.offline.en-US: Network lost; keeping the downloaded route. It refreshes when back online.
web.ride.offline.pt-BR: Sem rede; a rota baixada continua. Atualiza quando a rede voltar.
web.ride.offline.zh-Hans: 网络已断开，继续沿用已下载路线；恢复后自动刷新。

web.ride.recalibrating.comment: Ride alert after the page returns.
web.ride.recalibrating.en-US: Page resumed; recalibrating position and route…
web.ride.recalibrating.pt-BR: Página retomada; recalibrando posição e rota…
web.ride.recalibrating.zh-Hans: 页面刚恢复，正在重新校准位置与路线…

web.ride.start_speech.en-US: Navigation started; keep the page in the foreground
web.ride.start_speech.pt-BR: Navegação iniciada; mantenha a página na frente
web.ride.start_speech.zh-Hans: 导航开始，请保持页面在前台

web.ride.stats.comment: Accessible name of the ride figures.

web.ride.swipe.en-US: Swipe the round display to change pages
web.ride.swipe.pt-BR: Deslize a tela redonda para mudar de página
web.ride.swipe.zh-Hans: 左右滑动圆屏切换页面

web.route.back.comment: Button back to search on the route screen.

web.route.canvas.comment: Accessible name of the round display canvas.
web.route.canvas.en-US: Live round navigation display; swipe left or right for navigation, speedometer, compass and music
web.route.canvas.pt-BR: Tela redonda de navegação ao vivo; deslize para os lados para navegação, velocímetro, bússola e música
web.route.canvas.zh-Hans: 实时圆形导航画面；左右滑动可切换导航、马表、指南针和音乐

web.route.failed.en-US: Route planning failed; check the network and try again.
web.route.failed.pt-BR: O planejamento da rota falhou; verifique a rede e tente de novo.
web.route.failed.zh-Hans: 路线规划失败，请检查网络后重试。

web.route.generated.pt-BR: Rota gerada com o trânsito ao vivo.
web.route.generated.zh-Hans: 路线已按当前实时路况生成。

web.route.no_key.comment: Route error: the server has no AMap key.
web.route.no_key.en-US: The server has no AMap key yet.
web.route.no_key.pt-BR: O servidor ainda não tem a chave do AMap.
web.route.no_key.zh-Hans: 服务器还没有配置高德 Key。

web.route.off_route.comment: Ride alert when off the route.
web.route.off_route.zh-Hans: 已偏离路线，正在重新规划…

web.route.planning_traffic.comment: Route status while planning with traffic.
web.route.planning_traffic.pt-BR: Planejando com o trânsito ao vivo…
web.route.planning_traffic.zh-Hans: 正在根据实时路况规划路线…

web.route.reroute_failed.comment: Ride alert when a reroute fails.
web.route.reroute_failed.en-US: Replanning failed; keeping the current route. It retries once online.
web.route.reroute_failed.pt-BR: O replanejamento falhou; a rota atual continua. Tenta de novo quando houver rede.
web.route.reroute_failed.zh-Hans: 重规划失败，继续沿用当前路线。联网后会自动重试。

web.route.rerouting_status.en-US: Off route detected; replanning from your position…
web.route.rerouting_status.pt-BR: Saída da rota detectada; replanejando a partir da sua posição…
web.route.rerouting_status.zh-Hans: 检测到偏航，正在从当前位置重新规划…

web.route.summary.comment: Accessible name of the route summary.

web.route.switched.comment: Toast after switching to a new route.

web.runtime.aborted.comment: Runtime aborted; {reason} is the technical reason.

web.runtime.exited.comment: Runtime exited; {status} is the exit code.

web.runtime.load_failed.comment: Feedback when the display runtime fails.
web.runtime.load_failed.en-US: The shared navigation display failed to load; reload the page.
web.runtime.load_failed.pt-BR: A tela de navegação compartilhada não carregou; recarregue a página.
web.runtime.load_failed.zh-Hans: 共享导航画面加载失败，请刷新页面。

web.runtime.not_built.pt-BR: A tela de navegação compartilhada não foi compilada

web.runtime.not_ready.en-US: Location and the shared navigation display are not ready yet
web.runtime.not_ready.pt-BR: A localização e a tela de navegação compartilhada ainda não estão prontas
web.runtime.not_ready.zh-Hans: 定位和共享导航画面还未就绪

web.runtime.placeholder.comment: Text drawn on the round display while it loads.

web.search.after_location.pt-BR: Depois de localizar, busque lugares no país todo
web.search.after_location.zh-Hans: 定位后即可搜索全国地点

web.search.clear.comment: Accessible name of the clear button.

web.search.failed.en-US: Search failed; check the network and try again.
web.search.failed.pt-BR: A busca falhou; verifique a rede e tente de novo.
web.search.failed.zh-Hans: 搜索失败，请检查网络后重试。

web.search.found.one.comment: Search results count (CLDR plural 'one': 1 in English; 0 and 1 in Portuguese).

web.search.found.other.comment: Search results count (CLDR plural 'other'); {count} is a number.

web.search.no_key.comment: Search error: the server has no AMap key.
web.search.no_key.en-US: The server has no AMap key.
web.search.no_key.pt-BR: O servidor não tem a chave do AMap.

web.search.no_service.en-US: The AMap route service is not set up yet; search is unavailable.
web.search.no_service.pt-BR: O serviço de rotas do AMap ainda não está configurado; a busca não está disponível.
web.search.no_service.zh-Hans: 高德路线服务尚未配置，暂时不能搜索。

web.search.none.en-US: Nothing found; try adding the city or district.
web.search.none.pt-BR: Nada encontrado; tente incluir a cidade ou o distrito.
web.search.none.zh-Hans: 没有找到，试试加上城市或区县。

web.search.placeholder.en-US: City and place, for example: Jinan Olympic Sports Center
web.search.placeholder.pt-BR: Cidade e lugar, por exemplo: Centro Olímpico de Jinan
web.search.placeholder.zh-Hans: 输入城市和地点，例如：济南奥体中心

web.search.prompt.en-US: Enter a city and destination name.
web.search.prompt.pt-BR: Digite a cidade e o nome do destino.
web.search.prompt.zh-Hans: 输入城市和目的地名称。

web.search.results.comment: Accessible name of the results list.

web.setup.eyebrow.comment: Small caption above the main question.

web.setup.intro.en-US: Turn on location and search for a destination. Keep this page in the foreground while navigating.
web.setup.intro.pt-BR: Ative a localização e busque um destino. Mantenha esta página aberta na frente durante a navegação.
web.setup.intro.zh-Hans: 打开定位，搜索目的地。导航时让这个页面保持在前台。

web.setup.title.comment: Main question on the first screen.

web.status.amap_unusable.comment: AMap service not usable for live navigation.

web.status.author.comment: Credit line; {author} links to the author and {license} to the license.

web.status.close.comment: Accessible name of the close button.

web.status.language_system.comment: Language option that follows the browser; {language} is the language name.

web.status.license.comment: Link text to the noncommercial license.

web.status.lvgl_state.comment: Display runtime with navigation state; {state} is a state name.

web.status.requirements.comment: Requirement note in the status dialog.
web.status.requirements.en-US: Live navigation needs HTTPS, location permission and the screen on with the page in front. A locked web page cannot keep reliable location.
web.status.requirements.pt-BR: A navegação ao vivo precisa de HTTPS, permissão de localização e tela ligada com a página na frente. Com a tela bloqueada, a página web não mantém a localização com segurança.
web.status.requirements.zh-Hans: 真实导航要求 HTTPS、位置权限和前台亮屏。网页锁屏后不能继续可靠定位。

web.system.enable_location.comment: Status detail asking to enable location.

web.system.loading_screen.comment: Status while the round-display runtime loads.

web.system.loading_screen_detail.comment: Status detail while the runtime loads.

web.system.locating.comment: Status while the first fix is requested.

web.system.needs_key.comment: Status detail: the server has no AMap key.
web.system.needs_key.pt-BR: Falta a chave do serviço web do AMap
web.system.needs_key.zh-Hans: 需要高德 Web 服务 Key

web.system.no_service.comment: Status when the route service is not configured.

web.system.open.comment: Accessible name of the status button.

web.system.ready.comment: Status button when everything is ready.

web.system.route_api_down.comment: Status detail: the route API cannot be reached.

web.usage.copy.en-US: Location keeps running while the screen is on and the page in front; in the background or locked, the iPhone pauses location.
web.usage.copy.pt-BR: A localização continua com a tela ligada e a página na frente; em segundo plano ou com a tela bloqueada, o iPhone pausa a localização.
web.usage.copy.zh-Hans: 前台亮屏可持续定位；网页进入后台或锁屏后，iPhone 会暂停定位。
